motion_and_interactions.scroll_behavior: Smooth scrolling mandatory (use Lenis or similar).
motion_and_interactions.reveal: Fade up and staggered entrance for typography and grid items via framer-motion.

hover_effects.cards: Subtle inner orange glow (box-shadow) or border-color shift to #F05A26.
hover_effects.images: Scale transform (1.05) on hover within hidden overflow container. Grayscale to color transition for portfolio.

hero.layout: Full screen (100vh), absolute positioned video/image background with dark overlay (bg-black/60). Text centered or heavily left-aligned.
hero.visuals: Hero stage image. Large GC EPIC PRO typography.

about.layout: Asymmetric 2-column. Left: Overline, massive heading, descriptive text. Right: Layered image of team/backstage.
about.visuals: Team backstage view image. Highlight vibrant energy.

services.layout: Bento Grid (Control Room style). 1x3 or 2x2 asymmetric spans. Cards should feel like technical panels.

portfolio.layout: Horizontal scroll or Masonry grid of large event photos. Very little text, let the images breathe.
portfolio.visuals: High contrast conference and stage photos.

clients_marquee.layout: Continuous horizontal scroll (react-fast-marquee). High contrast, grayscale logos that colorize on hover.

testimonials.layout: Minimalist slider. Large quote marks in Yellow (#FFCB05).

stats.layout: 4-column grid. Massive numbers in GC EPIC PRO font, orange/yellow gradient text fill.

contact.layout: Split layout. Left: Contact info and bold CTA. Right: Clean, border-bottom only form fields.

footer.layout: Massive 'AXIZ' brand text spanning full width at the bottom. Clean links above.

hero_background.description: Modern corporate event stage with dramatic orange/yellow lighting

brand_pattern.description: Abstract wavy vibrant orange to bright yellow gradient lines

portfolio_events.description: Room filled with tables and chairs for conference
Crowd of people at business conference

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the custom font GC EPIC PRO Demo using a standard CSS @font-face rule pointing to the provided URL.
Use framer-motion heavily. The user explicitly asked for a 'highly animated' website. Incorporate parallax scroll effects, text reveals on scroll, and hover animations.
For the client logos marquee, use 'react-fast-marquee'.
Keep backgrounds deep black (#000000 to #0A0A0A) and use the vibrant orange (#F05A26) and yellow (#FFCB05) strictly as accents for borders, highlights, gradients, and typography overlines.
Borders should be sharp (rounded-none), echoing a premium, confident, slightly brutalist corporate event aesthetic.
Contact form needs to be fully wired up to save to the database as requested.
Ensure the hero section uses the hero_event_stage image with a dark overlay to maintain readability of the GC EPIC PRO typography.
